description: Presidential Secretariat - The Supply of Electricity All Service Work or Labour of any Description Care Feeding etc. as Essential Public Services
reasoning: This gazette contains an order by the President declaring certain services as essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. This constitutes a regulatory action that establishes legal requirements and compliance obligations for specified services (electricity supply and healthcare services), making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or structural announcement.
